identity.name: Caitro Soto
identity.full_name: Pedro Carlos Soto de la Colina
identity.summary: Afro-Peruvian cajón player and composer of Perú Negro, known for 'Toro Mata'.

contribution.description: One of the great cajoneros, whose cajón Paco de Lucía took from Lima to Spain in 1977, starting the instrument's journey into flamenco and around the world.

beatbreaker.songs_short_because: 15-b sweep (2026-10-22): Thin: few commercial tracks; De Cajón listing not confirmed beyond Toro Mata.
